Hi!

messages.subject: Re: Cancellation request — next steps
messages.snippet: Thanks for reaching out. To process a cancellation we need written confirmation with your member ID and 30 days' notice. Reply to this email to confirm.
messages.body:
Thanks for reaching out about cancelling.

To process a cancellation we need written confirmation that includes your member ID (it's on your key tag) and we require 30 days' notice from the date we receive it. Any renewal that lands inside the notice period will still be charged.

Reply to this email with "Please cancel my membership" and your member ID and we'll take it from there.

Member Support
Peak Fitness Club
